sections.title: Combinatorial Analysis
sections.description: Standard tools of enumerative combinatorics including partitions and compositions of integers, set partitions, generating functions, permutations with restricted positions, inclusion-exclusion, partially ordered sets. Permission of the instructor required to enroll.
